items.note: Remains resolved on the corrected bytes. The recap section, now headed 'Now install on your own computer', keeps the four numbered steps (architecture per OS, JDK 25 - LTS with package type JDK from Temurin plus the per-OS official guide, Maven from the official guide with a new completion check, new-terminal verification), the network-access statement, expected java -version / javac -version / mvn -v output with 'all three show 25' as the pass rule, troubleshooting with a stop-and-ask-your-instructor boundary, and the IntelliJ IDEA starter/pom.xml and SDK 25 check. The added note that ARM-based Windows learners should ask the instructor is an explicit boundary, not a gap in the path.
